works.title: Ruth Justice
works.description: A new character/voice for Main Street Independent—a retired Congressional Budget Office analyst who serves as the publication's financial expert and moral commentator on power concentration. Grounded in the Justitia archetype with specific visual design (older woman, white hair with wild curls, blindfold deliberately pulled aside), and characterized by cold contempt-driven analysis that exposes the structural corruption of financial and legal systems.
works.quote: Give me that reply in a typical output so I can actually listen to it on my phone
